brand_identity.name: FinnJob
brand_identity.mission: Connect students and gig workers with flexible jobs instantly.
brand_identity.aesthetic: Clean, Minimal, Soft Tech, Glassmorphism touches

primary.description: Deep Slate - Use for main headings, primary buttons, strong borders

secondary.description: Slate 100 - Use for secondary buttons, card backgrounds

accent.description: Teal 400 - The 'FinnJob' Brand Color. Use for CTAs, highlights, icons

accent_secondary.description: Sky 400 - Use for gradients with Teal

background.description: Pure White for cards, Slate 50 for page background

layout.grid_strategy: Use 'Bento' style grids for features. Avoid uniform 3-column grids everywhere. Mix spans.

buttons.primary: bg-primary text-primary-foreground hover:bg-primary/90 h-12 px-8 rounded-full font-medium transition-all hover:scale-105 active:scale-95 shadow-lg shadow-primary/20
buttons.secondary: bg-white border border-slate-200 text-slate-900 hover:bg-slate-50 h-12 px-8 rounded-full font-medium transition-all hover:border-slate-300

cards.job_card: bg-white rounded-2xl border border-slate-100 p-6 shadow-[0_2px_8px_-2px_rgba(0,0,0,0.05)] hover:shadow-[0_8px_24px_-4px_rgba(0,0,0,0.08)] transition-all duration-300 hover:-translate-y-1 group
cards.feature_card: bg-slate-50/50 rounded-3xl p-8 border border-slate-100 hover:bg-white transition-colors

inputs.default: h-12 rounded-xl border-slate-200 bg-white focus:ring-2 focus:ring-teal-400/20 focus:border-teal-400 transition-all

badges.default: bg-slate-100 text-slate-700 px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-sm font-medium
badges.brand: bg-teal-50 text-teal-700 border border-teal-100 px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-sm font-medium

visual_enhancers.decorations: Use subtle 'blob' gradients in the background (teal/sky) with heavy blur (blur-3xl) and low opacity (opacity-30) to add depth without clutter.

image_urls.logo_placeholder: Use text 'FinnJob' with Outfit font, Bold weight. The 'Finn' in Slate-900 and 'Job' in Teal-500.

media.icons: Use Lucide React icons. Stroke width 1.5px or 2px. Rounded line caps.

accessibility.contrast_check: Ensure Teal text is only used on dark backgrounds or as large headings. For body text on white, use Slate-600 or darker.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. SETUP: Install 'lucide-react' and 'framer-motion' if not present.
2. FONTS: Add the Google Fonts import to index.css immediately.
3. TAILWIND: Update tailwind.config.js to include the new colors (teal-400 as accent, slate-900 as primary).
4. LAYOUT: Build the Hero section first. Use the 'hero_main' image with a 'blob' shape mask or rounded-3xl container.
5. COMPONENTS: Create a reusable 'JobCard' component early. It's the core of the app.
6. NAVIGATION: Create a sticky glassmorphic navbar.
7. MOCK DATA: Create a 'jobs.js' file with 5-6 realistic mock jobs (Barista, Rider, Cashier, Tutor) to populate the list.
8. AUTH: Mock the login flow visually (clean form centered on screen).
9. DO NOT use generic 'lorem ipsum'. Write copy that sounds like a cool startup ('Get paid instantly', 'Work when you want').
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur)
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯📚🎭🎬🎪🎉🎊🎁🎀🎂🍰🎈🎨🎰💰💵💳🏦💎🪙💸🤑📊📈📉💹🔢🏆🥇 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
Main agent relies on these image URLs. Missing categories (especially sponsor logos) = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable
Create new components that match the style and conventions of existing components when needed
Examine existing components to understand the project's component patterns before creating new ones
Components MUST use named exports (export const ComponentName = ...)
Pages MUST use default exports (export default function PageName() {...})
Use sonner for toasts. Sonner component are located in /app/src/components/ui/sonner.tsx
